children: Oneok reported higher third-quarter profit and raised its full-year guidance, boosted by higher volumes from the Permian Basin.
The natural-gas transmission company posted net income of $1.35 billion, or $2.13 a share, up from $939 million, or $1.49 a share, the year prior. Analysts polled by FactSet expected $1.50 a share.
The company increased its full-year earnings guidance to a midpoint of $6.30, up from its previous forecast of $5.68 a share. Analysts see $5.76 a share.
"Results benefited from higher natural gas liquids, refined products and natural gas volumes and higher optimization and marketing activity," the company said.
